deliverables: Updated af_engine stage handlers with resilient transition logic
Updated atlasforge_conductor with exponential backoff and retry tracking
Updated dashboard_v2 with precise process discovery
Comprehensive suite of new functional and adversarial tests

next_mission_recommendation.mission_description: Implement a dedicated 'System Health' dashboard widget that visualizes retry trends, token usage spikes, and stage transition timing. Add automated self-healing for common CLI environment issues (stale locks, orphaned processes) and implement a 'Dry-Run' mode to validate mission plans against stage restrictions before execution.
next_mission_recommendation.rationale: Following the stabilization of core bugs, this mission will shift focus from reactive fixes to proactive observability and resilience, ensuring that future failures are transparent and automatically managed.

final_report.summary: This mission successfully resolved three critical reliability issues in the AtlasForge system. 1) Mission auto-completion was fixed by implementing aggressive normalization of status/recommendation strings (supporting 'complete', 'mission_complete', 'success', etc.) and enforcing transitions to the COMPLETE stage when cycle budgets are exhausted. 2) The CLI infinite restart loop was resolved by introducing exponential backoff for retries and ensuring that JSON parse failures correctly count towards the retry limit (3-strike rule). 3) Dashboard stale process state was fixed by prioritizing PID file checks and utilizing strict regex-based process detection in pgrep to eliminate false positives from decoy processes like 'tail' or 'grep'.
key_achievements: Implemented robust status normalization in the R&D engine stages to handle LLM response variation.
Enforced hard completion boundaries for missions at cycle budget limits.
Integrated exponential backoff (10s, 20s, 40s) for CLI retries to prevent API flooding.
Engineered resilient process detection in the Dashboard using /proc/ and filtered pgrep patterns.
Verified all fixes with adversarial tests covering malformed JSON, deceptive command lines, and whitespace edge cases.
challenges_overcome: Resolved a double-increment bug in the conductor that caused premature halts after 2 failures instead of 3.
Fixed dashboard false positives where log-monitoring commands (tail -f) were mistaken for the active conductor process.
Normalized whitespace in LLM recommendations that previously caused valid stage transitions to fail.
lessons_learned: Always use synonyms and case-insensitive normalization when relying on LLM-generated status fields.
State machines for autonomous agents must include cycle-based safety exits to prevent infinite loops.
Process monitoring should never rely on filename matching alone; command-line verification and PID files are essential for reliability.
